name: openspec-viewer
description: Render OpenSpec spec.md files as live Mermaid diagrams, always derived from the scenarios.

enumDescriptions: A flowchart per requirement. Uses the layout and AND style settings.
A state-machine style diagram (like xstate): GIVEN is the source state, WHEN the event, AND a guard, THEN the target state. Ignores the layout and AND style settings.
openspecViewer.diagram.renderer.description: Which kind of diagram to draw. Both use Mermaid.

enumDescriptions: The requirement leads to one decision diamond, with a branch per scenario (no diamond when there is a single scenario).
The requirement is one box listing its scenarios as numbered options; each option leads to its outcome.
The requirement leads to each scenario's condition and outcome separately, without a decision node.
openspecViewer.diagram.layout.description: How each requirement is laid out in the diagram. A requirement's scenarios are treated as alternatives of one decision. Only applies when the renderer is flowchart.

enumDescriptions: The WHEN is the entry condition; each AND becomes its own hexagon condition node in sequence.
All WHEN/AND lines go in one node, and all THEN/AND lines in another.
openspecViewer.diagram.andStyle.description: How AND lines are shown. Only applies when the renderer is flowchart.
